name: Minimal Smilodon
body:
Minimal Smilodon
CR 6

XP 2,400
Variant dire tiger
N Small animal
Init +8; Senses low-light vision, scent; Perception +12

DEFENSE

AC 16, touch 14, flat-footed 13 (+3 Dex, +2 natural, +1 size)
hp 77 (14d8+14)
Fort +10, Ref +13, Will +5

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft.
Melee bite +16 (1d6+4/19-20 plus grab), 2 claws +16 (1d4+4 plus grab)
Special Attacks pounce, rake (2 claws +16, 1d4+4 plus grab)

STATISTICS

Str 19, Dex 19, Con 13, Int 2, Wis 12, Cha 10
Base Atk +10; CMB +13 (+17 grapple); CMD 27 (31 vs. trip)
Feats Improved Critical (bite), Improved Initiative, Run, Skill Focus (Perception), Skill Focus (Stealth), Weapon Focus (bite), Weapon Focus (claw)
Skills Acrobatics +8 (+12 to jump), Perception +12, Stealth +24 (+28 in tall grass), Swim +10; Racial Modifiers +4 Acrobatics, +4 Stealth, +4 Stealth in tall grass Languages -167167

ECOLOGY

Environment warm forests and plains
Organization solitary, pair or den (6–10)
Treasure none

Minimals are small versions of normally Medium, Huge or Large sized animals and beasts. Any animal or generally animal-like beast (GM’s discretion) can become a minimal.

Dinosaurs and their ilk are most commonly found as minimals on isolated islands in the Mediterranean where entire miniature pre-historic eco-systems can be found.
